inputs.role: Edit target: preserve actual game world and King; redesign only HUD
King identity and existing portrait style reference
Existing material/palette reference; ornament silhouette may change

concepts.label: A — Relic Orbit
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset: original Battle of Gods pixel-action RPG gameplay HUD concept, a single full-screen 16:9 1536x864 presentation. Input image 1 is the actual current game screen: PRESERVE the top-down pixel-art forest terrain, paths, trees, small black-haired red-scarf King, his proportions and all world art. Remove/replace ONLY the old interface from this screen. Input image 2 is the approved King portrait and identity/style reference; retain his dark hair/red scarf/serious compact face. Input image 3 is a MATERIAL/palette reference only, not a required frame silhouette. Create a professionally designed, original compact fantasy HUD with crisp hard-edged pixel art, dark obsidian/slate panels, weathered silver/iron edging, ivory legible pixel typography, restrained cool cyan and violet runes, and deep red health. Never use broad gold borders, giant gilded wings, shiny vector gradients or a copied logo/UI asset. Keep the central 72% of the scene free for combat; no vignette obscuring the world, no big titles, no mockup board, no external labels or arrows. No minimap and no giant inventory button. Common information for ALL variants: one selected-target/boss panel at TOP CENTER with small root-monster portrait, exact name 'ROOTBOUND HUSK', 'Lv 8', red HP bar and '3,720 / 6,000', a very small casting bar 'ROOT SURGE' beneath plus at most three tiny status icons; a compact RIGHT UPPER objective tracker with 'FOREST EXPEDITION', 'Defeat Rootbound Husk' and 'Guardian 0 / 1', understated transparent backing. Small menu/bag controls at upper left reading 'BAG [TAB]' and 'MENU [ESC]'. Bottom-edge thin cyan-violet PLAYER XP strip reading '4,250 / 10,000 XP'. Exactly four normal skill icons marked '1','2','3','4' for KING powers, plus a smaller grouped strip of exactly four weapon techniques marked 'F1','F2','F3','F4'. F keys must be large enough to read, directly associated with their four slots. Include a small equipped greatsword badge and slim weapon mastery indicator labeled 'MASTERY 5'; at most three active boon icons immediately above the player-resource area. Only one clear cooldown number ('6.2') on a skill, a subtle unavailable icon treatment on another; all other slots read through painted glyphs, not repeated READY labels. One unobtrusive dodge indicator 'SPACE'. HP sample is '1,240 / 1,600' (one or two lines as the layout needs); level is '12'. All shown skills/quests/gauges are illustrative UI concept data. Respect hierarchy and realistic logical 960x540 readability: primary skill icons 32 logical pixels, function skills 24-28 logical pixels, text at least 10 logical pixels, generous screen-safe insets, no cropped UI. Everything must look genuinely usable on a small pixel RPG rather than an oversized MMO screenshot. FULL GAMEPLAY SCREEN with HUD, no real-world monitor. This is design-only: no game-engine debug menus, no existing-frame collage or detached anatomy.

VARIANT A: Guild-Wars-inspired COMPACT CENTRAL HEALTH ORB composition, original pixel-game styling. Make a small deep-crimson health orb (about 58 logical pixels diameter) in an angular weathered silver ring at BOTTOM CENTER. Exact HP digits in two compact stacked lines '1,240' and '/ 1,600' centered on the orb with level '12' on a small plate below. Four KING power squares form two on each side of the orb, keys 1 and 2 on its left, 3 and 4 on its right; total main HUD footprint about 410 logical pixels wide and 80 high, close to bottom edge. Four F1-F4 weapon techniques sit in one tight elevated row immediately above the LEFT half of the main bar, aligned rather than scattered. Greatsword/mastery badge immediately left of the bottom dock, dodge indicator immediately right. Use a restrained crescent/half-sun engraving in the orb rim; never copy Guild Wars dragon shapes. Small target bar top center and quiet quest right. This variant celebrates the red central orb and symmetrical skill dock without obstructing gameplay. Keep King's portrait only as a tiny token near the weapon badge, no duplicate HP panel in a corner.

VARIANT B: KING PORTRAIT COMMAND composition, clearly DIFFERENT from an orb layout. No circular red health orb anywhere. Build a bottom-center dock around the approved King FACE PORTRAIT in a compact faceted hexagonal iron medallion placed LEFT of the horizontal main strip. A thin vivid red HP bar stretches RIGHT from the portrait above the four aligned King power slots 1,2,3,4; exact '1,240 / 1,600' inside the HP bar. A small level '12' diamond overlaps only the portrait's lower edge. Four F1-F4 techniques form a distinct small row directly above the HP/skills section, with a tiny equipped GREAT SWORD silhouette and 'MASTERY 5' at its left. Dodge 'SPACE' is a small separate cell at dock right. The thin full-screen XP strip remains at absolute bottom edge. Total dock about 390 logical pixels wide and 92 high; silhouette is a compact horizontal asymmetric command panel, no giant wings and no duplicated corner portrait. Weathered iron and navy slate with tasteful cyan-violet glowing seams. Keep the original small King/world visible. Center target header and restrained right quest tracker match other variants.

VARIANT C: MINIMAL TWO-ROW STEEL RIBBON composition, deliberately DIFFERENT from A and B. No orb and no portrait built into the main action dock. Keep an exceptionally small King portrait/level token at TOP LEFT beside BAG/MENU, with NO health bars there. Bottom-center interface is a low wide horizontal slim steel ribbon about 450 logical pixels wide and only 68 high: a thin red HP strip '1,240 / 1,600' ABOVE the icons; below it one visually balanced row with four compact weapon techniques F1,F2,F3,F4 on the LEFT, a small vertical divider, and four King powers 1,2,3,4 on the RIGHT. A narrow weapon mastery bar labeled 'MASTERY 5' sits immediately above the LEFT group; small active greatsword badge at far left and SPACE dodge pip at far right. XP is an almost hairline cyan-violet full-width strip at absolute bottom with digits and a tiny level '12' badge at its left. Panels are near-black glass with crisp weathered pewter corners and subtle pixel-runic notches, the lightest ornamentation of the three directions. Large clear world area, top-center enemy/boss focus panel and compact translucent upper-right objective tracker. This is the clearest least intrusive action-game variant; it must still feel crafted and atmospheric rather than a bare modern vector wireframe.
